# Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst
## Location
United Kingdom
## Employment Type
Full time
## Location Type
Remote
## Department
GTM
OverviewApplication
***1Password is growing.** We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.*
**About 1Password**
*At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.*
*If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.*
We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst to help build and scale 1Password’s Commercial Deal Desk capability within Revenue Operations. You’ll partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams on complex commercial decisions, while turning what you learn into clear processes, guidance, and tools that help teams move faster with confidence. This role will help strengthen 1Password’s enterprise commercial capabilities as deal complexity and volume grow.
**How we’re using AI today**
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within the UK.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
**What we're looking for:**
* 4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, or a related function within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Salesforce Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ)/Revenue Cloud, including resolving complex quoting and cross-object issues.
* Strong understanding of commercial deal structures, including annual recurring revenue (ARR), multi-year agreements, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, stub billing, bundled products, and discounting.
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve processes, documentation, approval workflows, and commercial policies in an evolving environment.
* Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer and seller needs with pricing discipline, revenue integrity, and business risk.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to influence effectively without formal authority and explain complex commercial concepts clearly.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve the quote-to-cash process is preferred.
**What you can expect:**
* Partner with Enterprise Account Executives (AEs), Sales Managers, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on complex, non-standard, and high-impact deals.
* Advise on deal structure, pricing, terms, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, bundled products, and other commercial considerations.
* Review and execute deal submissions in Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, ensuring quotes and contracts are accurate, complete, and ready for approval and invoicing.
* Build the foundations of the Commercial Deal Desk, including intake processes, approval routing, discount governance, exception handling, service-level agreements (SLAs), and documentation.
* Create playbooks, training materials, office hours, and practical guidance that help sales teams navigate commercial processes and quoting tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tooling, and CPQ configuration, while partnering with technical teams to implement scalable solutions.
* Use deal data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks, improve deal quality, and recommend changes that support efficient, sustainable growth.
UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £60,000 GBP and £84,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. *This posting is for an existing vacancy.*
**Our culture** At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, *1Password is not for everyone*. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. **How we work with AI** We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. **Our approach to work** We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. **What we offer** We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: *Health and wellbeing* 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy *Growth and future* 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account *Community* 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment *\*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.*
**You belong here.**
*1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.*
*Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.*
*Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.*

* Background in cybersecurity, IAM, identity security, or enterprise IT preferred; former 1Password power user is a strong plus.
* Strategic success planning and multi-threaded stakeholder management across a complex portfolio.
* Commercial acumen: independently qualifies, advances, and documents expansion opportunities; manages negotiations without oversight.
* Designs and applies AI-assisted workflows to commercial execution; documents use cases in a shareable format.
* Strong Gainsight and Salesforce hygiene; consistent forecasting discipline.
* Highly autonomous; manages complex accounts without requiring managerial direction.
* Commercial thinker who connects customer outcomes to expansion potential naturally.
* Strong executive presence – adapts messaging across technical, operational, and C-suite audiences.
* Elevates teammates through knowledge sharing and informal mentorship.

### **Own and Grow Your Book of Business**
* Independently manage a portfolio of moderately to highly complex accounts – adapting success plans to each customer’s context without manager guidance.
* Maintain full success plan coverage; produce documented best practices and playbooks, applied broadly across accounts with measurable KPI improvement.
* Proactively identify and mitigate renewal risks; close risk CTAs with a high rate of success within defined timeframes.
### **Drive Adoption & Value Realization**
* Achieve strong Executive Sponsor attendance in EBRs across segments; EBRs are value-driven, data-backed, and consistently advance renewal confidence.
* Maintain commercial intelligence across strategic accounts – budget cycles, org changes, compliance mandates, and stack rationalization.
* Translate advanced 1Password capabilities into clear outcomes for VP and C-suite stakeholders; tie adoption to measurable ROI and long-term advocacy.
### **Lead Revenue Retention & Expansion**
* Achieve strong amendment and renewal upsell win rates; proactively source and advance expansion opportunities with documented context.
* Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end.
### **Operate with Strategic Rigor**
* Manage commercial objections, renewal negotiations, and competitive conversations independently – without escalation for standard to complex scenarios.
* Build and present business cases to customer champions; advance deals with enough depth to move through the pipeline with AE alignment.
### **Act as a Trusted Security Advisor**
* Deep working knowledge of the full 1Password product suite; design tailored success journeys connecting feature adoption to measurable business outcomes.
* Incorporate regulatory context, breach patterns, and competitive dynamics into EBRs with confidence.
* Design and share AI-assisted workflows with teammates in a replicable, documented format.
### **Collaborate & Enable**
* Lead joint account planning with your AE; cited by AEs as a proactive commercial collaborator who improves deal outcomes.
* Mentor Level B CSMs through call shadowing, ad hoc coaching, or onboarding support.
* Lead or co-lead cross-team initiatives; contribute tools or improvements adopted by peers.
### **Month 1 – Onboarding & Foundation**
* Develop fluency in 1Password’s full product suite, CS methodology, and commercial motion.
* By the end of Month 1, you will independently manage customer touchpoints and demonstrate clear understanding of renewal drivers across your portfolio.
### **Month 3 – Portfolio Ownership**
* Full ownership of your book with consistent EBR cadence and expansion sourcing.
* By Month 3, you are meeting key performance targets and expansion leads are flowing to Sales with documented context.
### **Month 6 – Strategic Impact**
* Operating at full commercial autonomy; contributing to team practices and mentoring peers.
* By Month 6, you are achieving top-tier customer satisfaction and recognized as a reliable commercial collaborator by your AE and cross-functional partners.

# Senior Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Engineer (UK)
* Remote, Hybrid
* + Portishead, England, United Kingdom
* Business Infrastructure
## Job description
**Why A‐Gas?**
At A‐Gas, what we do matters — every single day. We are a global leader in Lifecycle Refrigerant Management. We help industries reduce emissions, protect the environment, and transition to a more sustainable future.
Our goal is clear: to protect and improve the environment by effectively managing refrigerants throughout their entire lifecycle.
**Job Purpose**
A‐Gas is strengthening its global infrastructure and cyber resilience across IT and OT environments. We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Engineer who will support the Head of Infrastructure in designing and evolving secure, resilient infrastructure and network architectures. This role focuses on maximizing business continuity, eliminating single points of failure, and protecting critical assets. The position holder will identify and design mitigations for cyber vulnerabilities, working closely with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to execute remediation and validate outcomes. They will collaborate with OT engineers and Product Owners to ensure manufacturing systems, legacy operating systems, and critical business products remain available and secure.
**Essential Experience**
* 7+ years in infrastructure engineering, with strong exposure to security and resilience design.
* Expertise in VMware virtualization, Microsoft stack (Entra ID/Azure AD, Windows Server, Intune, M365, Defender, Sentinel).
* Proven experience designing redundant network architectures and implementing business continuity strategies.
* Familiarity with Meraki networking and firewall configuration for secure cross-business connectivity.
* Knowledge of CIS18 controls, NIST CSF, and Zero Trust principles.
* Strong scripting/automation skills (PowerShell, Bash) and ability to validate MSP deliverables.
**Desirable**
* Experience with PAM solutions (CyberArk or similar), SIEM/SOAR tuning, WAF, IDS/IPS.
* Exposure to industrial control systems (ICS) and OT security best practices.
**Certifications**
* AZ‐500 (Azure Security Engineer), SC‐100 (Cybersecurity Architect), CISSP, or equivalent.
**What do you get in return?**
* Competitive and attractive employment package
* Employer pension scheme
* Flexible working hours (depending on the role)
* Collective benefits program
* Employee Assistance Program (support for work and personal matters)
* Cycle to work scheme
* Team activities in summer and around Christmas
**Why choose A‐Gas?** Because your work contributes to something bigger:
* A safer climate

Owns the forecasting models from problem framing and data preparation through model validation, production integration, monitoring and adoption. The role works alongside the Planning & Performance Management practice and extends the range of propositions the practice is able to take to market, combining statistical rigour with finance-process understanding and decision-ready explanation.
Responsibilities
Build forecasting models on client financial and operational data, covering revenue, cost, cash, demand signals and underlying drivers, using appropriate classical, econometric, machine-learning or deep-learning approaches rather than a single preferred method.
Prepare and validate multi-source data, engineer internal and external drivers, address seasonality and structural change, and model hierarchical relationships across products, entities, geographies or cost centres.
Design rigorous back-testing and time-series cross-validation, compare against transparent benchmarks, and evaluate accuracy, bias, stability, calibration and business impact; reconcile forecasts across hierarchies where required.
Run scenario and sensitivity analysis to a standard that supports CFO-level interrogation, including stress cases, uncertainty ranges, forecast interventions and causal or counterfactual analysis where appropriate.
Produce variance explanation and commentary capable of withstanding challenge from an FP&A team, including plan-versus-actual decomposition, driver attribution, explainability, confidence and limitations.
Integrate models into the client planning cycle and EPM platform to support operational adoption, working with Data and ML Engineers on pipelines, APIs, model registry, versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and controlled override workflows.
Work with AI Engineers where forecasting intersects agentic workflow, including proactive variance alerting, hypothesis ranking and draft narrative generation, while retaining appropriate finance review and approval.
Document methods, data, assumptions, model limitations and validation evidence, and measure whether the solution improves decision quality, planning efficiency or forecast performance in use.
Essential experience
Depth in time series and forecasting methods, spanning classical and modern approaches, with the judgement to select appropriately, including seasonality, external regressors, rolling horizons and model trade-offs.
Python and the associated analytical stack, with experience of production or near-production deployment, together with SQL, Git, testing and reproducible analytical or ML pipelines.
Strong understanding of forecast evaluation, including time-series cross-validation, back-testing, benchmark selection, error and bias metrics, uncertainty and stability over time.
Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and implementing input, output and consistency checks that address data-quality risk in forecasting pipelines.
Ability to explain model behaviour to a finance audience and defend underlying assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and the practical implications for decisions.
Ability to work with FP&A, operational and technical stakeholders to align models with planning calendars, business assumptions, adoption workflows and measurable outcomes.
At least 6 years’ relevant professional experience

FP&A or financial planning domain knowledge, including driver-based planning, rolling forecasts, management reporting or variance analysis.
Causal inference or uncertainty quantification, Bayesian or probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation, optimisation or simulation.
MLOps or cloud data-science experience using platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure ML, SageMaker or Vertex AI.
Experience with Anaplan, OneStream, Pigment, Oracle EPM or SAP Analytics Cloud, including integration of external models or analytical services.
Experience with anomaly detection, automated narrative generation or agentic workflows for forecast monitoring and intervention.

Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations.
Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns.
Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation.
Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging.
Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support.
Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership.

Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial.
Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies.
Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls.
Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns.
Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable)
Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data.
Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria.
At least 4 years’ relevant professional experience

* Excellent organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and contributors at the same time.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with formal requirements, documents and submission deadlines.

## Description
### **About Albus Health**
Albus Health is an Oxford University spin-out transforming how health data is collected and used in clinical trials and drug development.
We have developed Albus Home, a contactless multisensory platform that continuously captures physiological and behavioural data during sleep without wearables or user interaction.
Although our technology includes a physical device, Albus is fundamentally a health-data technology company. Our devices collect sensor data, including audio and radar, and connect to our cloud infrastructure for remote management and data transfer. Signal-processing and machine-learning pipelines then transform this data into clinically useful measures such as cough counts, breathing rate and heart rate.
Our technology is already deployed internationally in clinical trials, primarily with pharmaceutical companies, and its use is growing rapidly.
### **The Role**
We are looking for a **Principal Systems Test & Automation Engineer** to take significant technical ownership of testing and test automation across the Albus platform.
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role spanning a complex, multi-component system including cloud software and infrastructure, data-processing pipelines, signal-processing and machine-learning algorithms, connected devices and supporting applications.
Our multidisciplinary platform requires more than simply executing predefined test cases. You will need to develop a deep understanding of how the overall system works, work closely with engineers and scientists to establish expected behaviour, identify the behaviours and risks that matter most, and translate product requirements and technical knowledge into clear, measurable and robust tests.
You will personally design and implement automated tests, develop and improve our testing frameworks and infrastructure, and help establish an effective verification approach across component, subsystem and system levels.
**This is a technically challenging and important role within Albus, with significant responsibility for the quality and reliability of a complex product.**
This is not a traditional Test Manager role: line management is limited and we are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays close to the technology and code, and has the curiosity and independence to investigate problems and drive improvements.
### **Why Join Albus Health?**
You will take ownership of a critical function within Albus, testing technology already deployed internationally and scaling rapidly. You will work across cloud software, data infrastructure, connected devices, signal processing and machine learning.
You will have significant freedom and ownership to improve our automation, test infrastructure, development and release processes, and to explore how AI-assisted approaches can make testing more effective.
The technical problems are unusually broad: validating complex data flows, testing interactions between multiple components and cloud services, verifying data-processing algorithms, investigating unexpected behaviour and helping ensure that software releases perform reliably in real-world use.
**This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing company, with substantial technical autonomy and the freedom to shape how testing is done as the product develops.**
### **Location & Working Arrangements**
This is an **Oxford-based hybrid role**, combining regular time working with the team in our Oxford office with flexibility to work from home.
For this role, we are offering flexible working hours, with core collaboration hours of **11am–4pm**. These flexible and hybrid arrangements are specific to this position.

* Personally design, implement and maintain automated tests, primarily using **Python**.

* Integrate testing effectively into development, CI/CD and release processes.
* Use AI-assisted tools where they can improve test design, automation, analysis, reporting or engineering productivity.
* Contribute to the continuing development of Albus's testing strategy, processes and quality system.
### About You
You are a **senior test engineer with strong automation skills, systems thinking, technical curiosity, initiative and a strong sense of ownership**.
You enjoy getting deeply into how complex systems work, identifying the behaviours, interactions and risks that matter most, and finding effective ways to test them. You are comfortable working independently, taking the initiative and personally writing the code needed to turn those ideas into robust tests.

London, UK | Dublin, Ireland
Artisan Partners Limited Partnership is seeking a Portfolio Oversight Analyst – Regulatory Reporting & Investment Compliance. * Oversee day-to-day MiFIR transaction and post-trade transparency reporting, monitoring submissions to the regulatory reporting provider, confirming successful processing and onward reporting, and resolving rejected, missing, delayed, or inaccurate reports
* Reconcile UK and EU EMIR trade repository data to internal books and records, investigate breaks, and drive resolution with counterparties and internal stakeholders
* Own regulatory reporting exception tracking and escalation, maintaining clear status and aging and ensuring timely communication with internal stakeholders and clients, as appropriate
* Lead root-cause analysis of recurring reporting issues and partner with Technology, data teams, and external providers to improve data quality, mappings, processes, and controls
* Partner with UK and US Legal and Compliance on regulatory developments affecting MiFIR and EMIR and support updates to procedures, testing, and operational controls as requirements evolve

* Review overnight and batch compliance results for assigned investment strategies, investigating alerts and resolving or escalating issues in accordance with internal procedures

* Contribute to projects and process improvements across Portfolio Oversight and Trade Operations
## Qualifications
The successful candidate will possess strong analytical and critical thinking skills, sound judgment, and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:
* Undergraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5+ years of relevant experience in investment management, regulatory reporting, trade operations, investment compliance, or a related function
* Hands-on experience with MiFIR transaction reporting, post-trade transparency reporting, and/or EMIR derivatives reporting; experience across both MiFIR and EMIR strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience investigating regulatory reporting exceptions, reconciliations, and data quality issues through resolution
* Strong understanding of securities trading and investment operations; experience with equities, fixed income, and derivatives preferred
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with demonstrated ability to independently assess, prioritize, and resolve time-sensitive issues
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Trading, Legal, Compliance, Technology, counterparties, and external service providers

* Ability and willingness to develop expertise in client investment guidelines, compliance rule coding, security reference data, and the broader responsibilities of the Portfolio Oversight team

* Experience with security reference data, instrument identifiers, and front-to-back investment data flows preferred
* Experience using SQL within Snowflake or a similar data environment and familiarity with Python for data analysis preferred
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
* Availability to support European trading hours and occasional cross-region coordination outside standard local business hours

## The timing.
This role is upcoming. We open roles when the client work that pays for them is contracted, and this one is tied to a programme we expect to start in the coming months. We would much rather meet the right person early than hire in a hurry. If it reads like you, please get in touch now, and we will speak to you first when it opens.
## The role.
You would lead the build of an AI tool that helps rail engineers review the design submissions they receive from designers and contractors. A working prototype exists and has been demonstrated to engineering teams. The job is to take it to a production system that a large infrastructure client can deploy, govern and trust. The founder stays close to the product and owns the rail judgement and the client relationship. The engineering would be yours, end to end.
## What you would do.
* Take a working prototype to production. Architecture, build and deployment, then iteration with the engineers who use it.
* Build grounded extraction over long engineering documents: design statements, calculations, specifications and, in time, drawings. Every output should trace back to its source.
* Design the evaluations. Test sets, accuracy and consistency measures, so that what we claim is what we have measured.
* Connect the tool to the client’s document systems and sign-in (Microsoft 365, SharePoint, ProjectWise, single sign-on), and see it through their IT security and AI governance review.
* Sit with the engineers who use it. Take their requirements, and explain plainly what the tool can and cannot do.
## What we look for: technical.
* You have shipped LLM applications to real users. Retrieval, structured extraction or agents, running in production.
* Full-stack enough to own a product: TypeScript and React at the front, Python or Node behind it, Postgres underneath.
* An evaluation habit. You measure before you claim.
* Experience of enterprise integration and security review, for example Microsoft Graph, document management systems or single sign-on.
* A plus: vision models on technical drawings, knowledge graphs, or work in a document-heavy regulated sector.
* The work centres on building and shipping LLM applications. Training models from scratch plays a small part, if any.
## What we look for: character.
This matters as much as the code.
* **Patience and focus.** Real progress in this sector is earned over long cycles. The right person is energised by the slow, deliberate relationship build, and stays steady through it.
* **Curious** and genuinely excited by change. Happy to explore things that might not work.
* **Client-confident.** Comfortable in front of clients and leading a technical discussion.
* **Honest.** You will say when something needs to pivot. That one matters most.
## Sector experience.
A background in civil, rail or infrastructure engineering would be a real advantage, though it is not a requirement. What matters most is curiosity: a genuine appetite to learn how the railway reviews and assures its designs.
## Location and eligibility.
* This is a full-time, hybrid role. The founder is based in Guildford, Surrey, and regular in-person time is part of how we work. We are best placed to bring on someone within reach of Surrey, Oxford or London who is comfortable meeting in person from time to time.
* You will need the right to work in the UK.
## The package.
* **Salary plus equity,** calibrated to your capability and experience.
* We are bootstrapped and scale with the contracts we win. If you would value ownership, near-term revenue and independence over a hyperscale sprint, this could suit you well.
* It would often start as a paid, milestone-funded engagement on the live build, so that we can both find out whether it fits before a permanent role.
## About the founder.
Bill Guo, FICE CEng MEng. Chartered Civil Engineer and ICE Fellow with a decade on major UK rail programmes, building AutomateX to systemise how the sector works. You would be joining someone with the domain, the relationships and a live pipeline.
### Next step.
If this sounds like you, we would be glad to hear from you now. Email Bill at **bill.guo@automatex.uk** with a few lines about you and the most useful thing you have shipped. We will be in touch as soon as the role opens.

As part of this process, you will assess the individual credit profile of each institution, calculate its internal rating and determine an appropriate risk appetite across different products and types of exposure.
* **Understanding and assessment of the products and transactions generating exposure to financial institutions**, considering their specific credit and settlement risk characteristics when defining limits and risk appetite.
* **Close and regular interaction with Business**, discussing risk needs, proposed transactions and limits prior to their submission to committee. The role also involves coordination with other GRM teams across geographies and with local credit risk teams, which in turn interact with their respective local business areas.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Capital IQ Pro & experience using AI tools and an interest in applying them to credit risk processes will also be valued.

* Support collation of cyber and liability portfolios for monthly roll-up processes and monitoring of risk appetites. For example, monitoring portfolio aggregations and trends, and identifying material changes in exposure profile, data quality or modelled loss.
Strategic Engagement & View of Catastrophe Risk:
* Involved in strategic discussions on catastrophe modelling methods, including engagement with transformation projects and overall team strategy.

* Develop, maintain and own documentation, files and controls on cyber and liability modelling processes, tools and governance.
* Identify and execute process and control improvements, including exposure and results data.
* Contribute to third-party model system upgrades, including user acceptance testing and implementation activities to support the effective adoption of new model versions.

**Working hours:** 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday
**Duration:** 12-month FTC
**Location:** Gloucester
**Job Ref:** 205532
---
#### About the role
**Ecclesiastical Insurance**, who are proudly part of **Benefact Group** are looking for a **Assistant Reinsurance Technician** to join our **Gloucester** office.
The **Assistant Reinsurance Technician** provides administrative and technical support to the Reinsurance and Underwriting teams, ensuring accurate and timely processing of reinsurance transactions and reporting activities. This role will support day to day referrals, key reporting and control processes and contributes to the optimal placement of property reinsurance alongside third party arrangements.

Join a collaborative and inclusive culture that’s committed to making a difference and building a more sustainable future. * Previous relevant experience would be advantageous
---

# School Ambassador, UK
* Ops
* London
* Part-time
* Hybrid
**You are our face on campus, connecting Benford with the strongest tech and finance students at your university. You own how people at your school first hear about us, and who we meet next.**
## Why Benford
Audit at the small and mid-market end has been abandoned while fees keep rising. The largest firms are stepping back, and every previous attempt to modernise audit aimed at the auditor's desk and left the firm untouched.
We went the other way and built a vertically integrated audit firm. We hold the licence, we build the platform and we employ the auditor who signs. Our engine, AuditOS, connects to the systems a company runs on, and carries the work from one year to the next so the second audit starts where the first finished. Routine work is done by systems, judgement stays with people.
## What you'll own
* Benford's presence at your university: who knows us, what they think we do, and how they hear about roles and internships
* Events on campus and with us, from talks and coffee chats to hackathons, shaped the way you think will actually land
* The relationships that matter, with societies, course leads and the individuals you think we should be talking to
* Honest signal back to us on what students care about and where we are getting the pitch wrong
## Who we're looking for
* A current UK university student with real reach in tech, engineering or finance circles
* Range. You are comfortable writing, organising and pitching, often in the same week
* Early enough in our story that what you build becomes the way we recruit
* You are curious about how a new generation of companies gets built, and you want to be close enough to see it
## Practical
Part-time, hybrid, based in the UK with time alongside the team in London.

# AI Product Engineer
* Engineering
* London
* Full-time
* On-site
**You will own how AI does real audit work inside AuditOS, from the first prototype to something clients depend on. This is product engineering where the product is the audit itself.**
## Why Benford
Audit at the small and mid-market end has been abandoned while fees keep rising. The largest firms are stepping back, and every previous attempt to modernise the work aimed at the auditor's desk and left the firm untouched.
We are vertically integrated instead. We hold the licence, we build the platform and we employ the auditor who signs. AuditOS connects to the systems a company runs on, ERP, subledgers, invoices and banks, and carries the work from one year to the next so the second audit starts where the first finished. Routine work is done by systems, judgement stays with people.
## What you'll own
* Agentic workflows over client accounting systems, from harness and evaluation to what an auditor actually sees.
* A problem end to end: you pick it up, decide how to solve it and take it to market in the product.
* The control and evidence layer around the models, so every input is logged, traced to its source and assigned to a named auditor.
* The feedback loop with the auditors who use what you build, every week.
## Who we're looking for
* Depth in LLM development, harness building or LLM product engineering. Strong in one, able to operate across the stack when it counts.
* Evidence over seniority. What you have shipped matters more than years. Side projects count.
* You build with AI natively, not bolted on afterwards.
* You think about what does not exist yet, not about what is currently done.
## Our stack
Fundamentals matter more than familiarity with any specific tool. If you are strong, you will pick it up.
* AI layer: agentic document workflows over client accounting systems, with every step logged and attributable to a named auditor. The hard part is not the model, it is control and evidence.
* Integrations: direct connections into ERPs, subledgers, banks and invoicing systems. Messy, real, and where most of the value is.
## Practical
Full-time, on-site in London. Competitive salary and equity.

### Description

The Bermuda Monetary Authority (Authority or BMA) is seeking the services of a skilled and capable individual to work as a Principal – Insurance Intermediaries in our Supervision (Insurance, Funds and Corporate Authorisations) Department. Reporting to the Assistant Director, the Principal – Insurance Intermediaries will be responsible for directing a team of professionals responsible for the risk-based prudential and conduct supervision and regulation of insurance intermediaries, including insurance managers, brokers, agents and other registrants, in accordance with the Insurance Act 1978 and related rules, regulations, codes and guidance.
**This is a key role for the Authority and the postholder will be responsible for but not limited to:**
• Leading a multi-disciplinary team of professionals in the on-site and off-site supervision of insurance intermediaries, including insurance managers, brokers, agents and other registrants • Undertaking risk-based analysis of regulated entities to determine supervisory priorities, annual supervisory plans and the appropriate scope and intensity of supervisory activities • Overseeing regulatory reviews, compliance assessments and other supervisory work, and ensuring that findings, recommendations and proposed courses of action are clear, proportionate and supported by appropriate analysis • Monitoring regulated entities’ remediation of supervisory findings and breaches, escalating material concerns and recommending appropriate regulatory action where necessary • Reviewing licensing, registration and other regulatory applications relating to insurance intermediaries and ensuring that recommendations are timely, consistent and risk-based • Applying appropriate risk-based methodologies when allocating supervisory resources and ensuring that the team meets agreed supervisory objectives and service standards • Identifying sector trends, emerging risks and opportunities regulatory compliance, together with strong knowledge of insurance regulation, risk-based supervision and the Bermuda insurance market • The ability to interpret and apply legislation, rules, regulations, codes, guidance and other technical material, with working knowledge of relevant international regulatory standards and developments affecting insurance intermediaries • Experience a demonstrated ability to set direction, manage performance and develop staff • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy • in the financial services industry, including InsurTech, FinTech, SupTech and other digital applications

This is an exciting opportunity to join a truly **greenfield product**, playing a key role in shaping its vision, defining its roadmap and influencing its evolution from the earliest stages through to market growth and scale. You will have the chance to make a tangible impact, helping to build and refine a product that delivers exceptional value to customers while supporting the company's strategic ambitions.
Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will be responsible for driving product direction, identifying opportunities for innovation and ensuring the product continues to meet user needs while staying ahead of market trends, customer expectations and regulatory requirements. Whilst previous iGaming experience is advantageous, we are looking for someone who is excited by the industry, commercially aware and eager to learn.
The ideal candidate will be forward-thinking, highly organised and detail-oriented, with a willingness to contribute at every level. We value Product Managers who are hands-on, curious and passionate about their craft, whether that's contributing to product strategy, getting into delivery detail, analysing customer insights or collaborating with teams to solve complex problems.
At Betable Group, we actively encourage involvement in the wider product community. We look for individuals who stay engaged with industry trends, share ideas and insights and contribute to the profession through channels such as LinkedIn, product forums, conferences and meetups. With a team based in Manchester, we support attendance at product networking events, community meetups and online discussions as part of our commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

**Key Responsibilities**
· Develop and articulate a clear vision for the gaming product, aligned with the company's overall strategic objectives. Identify market opportunities and define product roadmap priorities based on customer feedback, industry trends and competitive analysis.
· Demonstrates a strong product mindset, with curiosity about the why behind customer needs, business problems and product opportunities.
· Understands the fundamentals of UX and UI, with strong attention to detail and an appreciation for creating simple, intuitive customer experiences.
· Is highly proficient in Jira, comfortable managing backlogs, creating well-defined tickets, prioritising work and supporting development teams through delivery.
· Uses customer feedback, research, analytics and experimentation to understand problems, validate ideas and improve products.
· Works effectively with Product Designers, Developers and other stakeholders within cross-functional teams.
· Working with our Compliance team to consider all legal and regulatory requirements in relevant jurisdictions, ensuring applicable laws and industry standards for responsible gambling and data protection are considered.
· Is comfortable translating customer and business problems into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
· Can confidently participate in discovery, planning, refinement, release management & product go live support.
· Thrives in a fast-moving environment, learning quickly and adapting when priorities change.
· Takes ownership of their work, follows problems through to resolution and understands that shipping the feature is not the end of the product lifecycle.
· Is commercially curious and developing an understanding of how product decisions contribute to customer value and business outcomes.
· Brings a hands-on, collaborative attitude, willing to get into the detail while developing their product management craft.
· Champion the user experience by defining intuitive workflows, designing engaging interfaces, and optimising customer journeys to maximise user satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
· Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and establish mechanisms for tracking product performance against business objectives.
· Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on product development progress, soliciting feedback and aligning expectations to ensure successful outcomes.
**Experience and Skills**
· Experience as a product owner or product manager
· Experience in Product Management, ideally across digital products on web and mobile platforms.
· Strong product mindset with curiosity about customer needs, business challenges and product opportunities.
· Experience working with customer feedback, analytics, research and experimentation to drive decision-making.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

You’ll typically manage 3–6 live projects at a time, ranging from fast-moving short projects to complex multi-faceted projects lasting several months.

# Sales Enablement and Partner Marketing Manager
**Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable**
Most sales enablement roles ask you to maintain what's already there. This one asks you to build it.
This is a newly created role within Blue Light Card's B2B Marketing function, sitting within the Partnerships team and reporting to the Senior B2B Marketing Manager. There are strong foundations to build from, but the Sales Enablement capability itself is new, giving you real scope to shape the tools, programmes and ways of working that help Partnerships have better, more confident commercial conversations.

**What You'll Do**
* Build the Sales Portal as the central hub for the Partnerships team, giving partner managers easy access to relevant collateral, objection handling, case studies, messaging guidance, and meeting preparation tools
* Translate BLC’s B2B go-to-market strategy and commercial proposition into practical sales enablement that supports priority account and category activity and helps the Partnerships team have better, more confident conversations with partners
* Own and deliver ongoing sales enablement and training for the Partnerships team, including onboarding, refresher sessions and the rollout of new tools, materials and approaches.
* Develop and manage targeted partner communications through HubSpot and other channels, including taking ownership of the partner newsletter from planning and delivery through to measurement and improvement

* Support the rollout of scalable long-tail partner communications and partner-facing reporting, managing workflows once the underlying approach is in place

* Build repeatable and scalable ways of working across sales enablement, partner communications, and GTM activation, drawing on live activity and stakeholder insight to raise the bar over time

job_description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
As the Product Owner for Agentic Workforce Automation within Tech@BCG, you will own the product vision and backlog for several agents that shifts common, repeatable tasks across Tech@BCG, spanning Change & Communications, User Research & Design, Enterprise Architecture, and other business-facing functions — onto a non-human, AI-driven workforce. Working in close partnership with AI Engineers, you will identify and prioritize which tasks and workflows are best suited for automation, translate business needs and stakeholder input into clear requirements and acceptance criteria for AI agents, and define the success metrics — throughput, quality, adoption, and cost-to-serve — that prove out the value of shifting work to agents.
You will serve as the primary voice of the business and the end user within the agentic workforce initiative, building and prioritizing a backlog that balances quick wins with longer-term automation opportunities, running discovery with stakeholders across Tech@BCG to surface candidate tasks, and making the call on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs as the platform evolves from event-driven AI capabilities toward increasingly autonomous, multi-agent systems capable of owning end-to-end workflows. You will partner with engineering to shape what "good" looks like for each agent, own change management and adoption across impacted teams, and ensure the pace of automation stays aligned with governance, Responsible AI principles, and the realities of how Tech@BCG actually works.
YOU’RE GOOD AT
Approaching highly complex, ambiguous automation opportunities in a structured way — proactively driving to solutions, identifying and framing root causes such as unclear ownership or process, and resolving escalated challenges independently while mitigating their broader impact on the business.
Framing complex and ambiguous information clearly for a range of audiences, and leading conversations and meetings effectively — modulating your style to audience and context, encouraging open dialogue, and developing a narrative that influences both engineering leaders and business stakeholders across Tech@BCG to reach resolution.
Structuring, planning, and driving a complex, cross-functional backlog that provides leverage to senior leadership; anticipating and managing changing priorities while proactively identifying risks to adoption and developing mitigation plans mindful of broad business impact.
Partnering effectively with diverse teams and broad networks — AI Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, and the business-facing teams whose work is being automated — while building and deepening strong stakeholder relationships, seeking to help and develop others, and striking the right balance between advocating for the roadmap and staying open to input.
Embracing change with adaptability and agility, bringing curiosity and creativity to continually evolve how the team works, while performing with the highest level of integrity and a growth mindset that generates trust across the organization.
What You'll Bring
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, or equivalent product/agile certification is a plus
10+ years of product management or product owner experience, including demonstrated leadership owning the roadmap and backlog for enterprise-scale platforms (must have).
Demonstrated experience owning products or platforms involving enterprise AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation, with a working understanding of agent architectures, model evaluation, and Responsible AI principles sufficient to partner credibly with AI engineering leadership.
Hands-on experience running discovery with business stakeholders to identify automation candidates, writing user stories and acceptance criteria for AI agents, and defining success metrics (throughput, quality, adoption, cost-to-serve) that hold agentic workflows to the same bar as human-delivered work
Who You'll Work With
You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team focused on shifting common, repeatable work across Tech@BCG onto a non-human, AI-driven workforce. You'll partner most closely with the AI Engineer, Senior Manager and their engineering team — pairing your view of business needs and priorities with their technical judgment on what's feasible — and will engage regularly with Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business-facing Tech@BCG teams to identify automation opportunities, validate requirements, and drive adoption of agentic AI practices across the function. ## **About the role**
The Senior Product Designer is responsible for shaping complex product experiences that require a strong understanding of user needs, business objectives, and system dependencies. The role focuses on structuring end-to-end user journeys, translating research insights into practical design solutions, and supporting teams in navigating ambiguous problem spaces.
The initial primary focus of this role is bp’s **enterprise design system** — designing and maintaining the tokens, components, and patterns that keep bp’s digital products consistent, accessible, and easy to build. Over time, the role will transition to contribute across the broader Developer Experience (DevEx) portfolio, including the internal developer platform and its tooling, and AI-enabled developer tooling.
Work at this level requires strong foundations in interaction design, service thinking, and visual design. The role contributes to the development of scalable product patterns and ensures design outcomes remain consistent with established systems and accessibility standards. Ensuring EAA / WCAG AA compliance across all design-system tokens and components is a core driver of this role, not an afterthought.
Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools and product capabilities, supports informed design decisions and efficient design workflows.
**Please note that roles based out of SJS or Sunbury will move to Timber Square, Southwark, from Q4 2027.**
## **You will work with**
This role operates across the design-system federation model, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers — both within the Design Engineering team and across the product teams adopting the design system. Partnership with frontend engineers is central, ensuring strong consistency between Figma designs and delivered code.
Engagement may also extend to federation delegates, content, operations, and support teams when product experiences intersect with broader operational processes. The team values thoughtful discussion, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing. Designers contribute to maintaining strong design practices while driving adoption of the design system across disciplines.
## **What you will delive**r
* **Design-system ownership:** Own and evolve the design system — define and maintain tokens, components, and patterns in Figma; produce usage guidance, specifications, and documentation; and enable teams to adopt the system correctly and consistently.
* **Figma-to-product consistency:** Act as the design guardian for the design system, ensuring components are used correctly across products and partnering with engineers to close design-to-build gaps between Figma and delivered code.
* **Accessibility ownership:** Ensure design-system components meet EAA / WCAG AA requirements by design — embedding accessibility into specifications, states, and usage guidance, and considering all component states and edge cases.
* **Research and insight synthesis:** Plan or support interviews, usability testing, and behavioural observation, synthesising findings into journey maps, experience principles, and structured design recommendations.
* **Experience design:** Define user journeys, task flows, and interaction patterns for complex product workflows. Service blueprints may be created to illustrate user interactions and supporting system processes.
* **Design execution and prototyping:** Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces using established design systems and accessibility standards.
* **Design facilitation and collaboration:** Facilitate workshops, feedback sessions, and collaborative discussions to improve design outcomes and support shared understanding across product and engineering teams.
* **AI-assisted design exploration:** Use AI-supported tools for exploration, research synthesis, or documentation, with attention to accuracy, ethics, and inclusivity.
**What you will need to be successful**
You do not need to meet every point below. If you have a strong combination of the essential criteria and are keen to grow into the rest, we would love to hear from you.
## Essential
* You have several years of hands-on product design experience delivering complex digital experiences.
* You have designed and maintained enterprise design systems — creating and evolving tokens, components, and patterns that scale across multiple products.
* You design fluently in Figma, using modern features such as variants, tokens, componentisation, and structured dev-handover.
* You apply accessibility standards in your work, designing to meet WCAG AA / EAA requirements and accounting for all component states.
* You can show, through a portfolio, how you reason through problems, design interactions, and make progress in ambiguous situations.
* You plan or contribute to user research and turn what you learn into structured design decisions.
* You explain and defend design decisions clearly in writing and discussion, and you work closely with engineers on design-to-code handover (without needing to write production code).
## Desirable
* You have any combination of experience facilitating workshops, critiques, or cross-functional alignment sessions.
* You are comfortable exploring AI-assisted tools and workflows for research synthesis, exploration, or documentation.
* You have supported the growth of other designers through mentoring, pairing, or feedback.
* You have familiarity with frontend technologies sufficient to hold productive feasibility conversations with engineers.
At this level, the Senior Product Designer contributes to initiatives spanning multiple product areas or teams. Their work connects insights, product priorities, and operational considerations to deliver scalable design outcomes. Informal mentorship and fostering alignment across teams is a key aspect of the role.

## Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu (PCEP)
Bydd ymgeiswyr llwyddiannus yn ymuno â Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu (PCEP), sef llwybr mynediad dwy flynedd Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain ar gyfer swyddogion heddlu newydd.
Nid oes angen gradd arnoch i wneud cais ac ni fydd gofyn i chi gwblhau gradd fel rhan o'r rhaglen.
Mae'r PCEP yn cyfuno dysgu yn yr ystafell ddosbarth, dysgu o bell, hyfforddiant yn seiliedig ar senarios a phrofiad gweithredol ymarferol er mwyn eich arfogi â'r wybodaeth, y sgiliau a'r ymddygiadau sydd eu hangen ar gyfer plismona rheng flaen.
### Yn ystod yr hyfforddiant, byddwch yn dysgu sut i:
* Defnyddio pwerau plismona yn gyfreithlon ac yn effeithiol
* Atal ac ymchwilio i droseddau
* Diogelu pobl fregus
* Ymateb i ddigwyddiadau ac argyfyngau
* Cefnogi dioddefwyr a thystion
* Cadw teithwyr, staff y rheilffyrdd a chymunedau lleol yn ddiogel
Wrth i'ch gyrfa ddatblygu, bydd gennych gyfleoedd i arbenigo mewn meysydd megis yr Adran Ymchwiliadau Troseddol (CID), Gwrthderfysgaeth a County Lines. P'un a ydych yn dymuno dod yn dditectif, ymuno ag uned arbenigol, datblygu fel arweinydd neu barhau i adeiladu arbenigedd mewn plismona rheng flaen, byddwn yn cefnogi eich uchelgeisiau bob cam o'r ffordd.

Yn ogystal â'r uchod, rhaid i chi hefyd feddu ar:
* Cymhwyster Lefel 3 neu uwch (gweler y manylion isod), **NEU**
* Brofiad gwaith perthnasol sy'n dangos lefel gyfatebol o wybodaeth, cyfrifoldeb a gallu proffesiynol (gweler y manylion isod).

* Dau gymhwyster Safon Uwch ar radd E neu uwch (neu gymhwyster cyfwerth, megis BTEC Lefel 3, T Levels Lefel 3 neu'r Fagloriaeth Ryngwladol (IB))

* NVQ Lefel 3
* Diploma Mynediad i Addysg Uwch
* Cymwysterau Lefel 3 cydnabyddedig eraill
* Profiad mewn plismona; O leiaf 12 mis o brofiad perthnasol, gan gynnwys gwasanaeth fel: Cwnstabl Gwirfoddol Arbennig (gyda statws patrol annibynnol), Swyddog Cymorth Cymunedol yr Heddlu (PCSO), Aelod o staff yr heddlu. Rhaid bod y gwasanaeth hwn wedi'i gwblhau o fewn y pum mlynedd diwethaf.

# Police Officer - Basingstoke
## Job Introduction
**Now recruiting Police Officers in Basingstoke**
**Join British Transport Police through our Police Constable Entry Programme** *"BTP truly is a unique police* *force* *with a real family* *feel**. We care deeply about what we do; serving the public and* *supporting* *our people. Our work matters.* *If you want to make a positive difference to the millions of people who use the network every day, BTP is the place for you**."* **– Chris Casey, Divisional Commander, London and South East England**
**Become a Police Officer in our B Division**
We are recruiting Police Officers at **Basingstoke** **\*\* Holding a valid full UK driving licence is essential for all locations included on this advert \*\* Please note:**We are only recruiting for the locations specified in this advert. If these locations are not suitable for you, we kindly ask that you wait for a future campaign that aligns better with your preferred location.
### Could this be the role for you?
As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in keeping millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. Working across one of the busiest transport networks in the world, you'll face unique challenges, develop valuable skills and make a real difference to people's lives.
No two days are the same. One moment, you could be supporting a vulnerable person in crisis. The next, you might be responding to an emergency, investigating crime, safeguarding a child, disrupting criminal activity or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life.
This is a career where your actions matter. Every interaction provides an opportunity to protect, support and positively impact the communities we serve.
You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by experienced colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and build a rewarding career.
We offer one of the most competitive starting salary packages for Police Constables in England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to specialise throughout your policing career. **What you'll get in return**
A successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, industry-leading travel benefits, strong family-friendly policies, comprehensive wellbeing support and ongoing opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
* **Starting salary:** **£33,609 (plus additional paid allowances stated below)**, rising year-on-year to **£52,014** after five years
* **South East Allowances**: £2,000 from day 1 of training.
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one
* Strong support for work-life balance, including 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave, alongside paternity leave, carers' leave, adoption leave and special leave provisions
### What we're looking for
You do not need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.
Whether you're changing careers, leaving education, returning to work or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed. There is no single background that makes a great police officer. Some of our officers join directly from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, customer service, retail, hospitality, transportation, the military and many other professions.
What matters most is your integrity, commitment to helping others and willingness to learn. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and can build positive relationships with people from all walks of life.
**Key qualities include:**
* Strong communication skills
* Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
* Empathy and emotional resilience
* The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure
**Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP)**
Successful candidates will join the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), British Transport Police's two-year entry route for new police officers.
You do not need a degree to apply and you will not be required to complete a degree as part of the programme.
PCEP combines classroom learning, remote learning, scenario-based training and practical operational experience to equip you with the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for frontline policing.
During training, you'll learn how to:
* Use policing powers lawfully and effectively
* Prevent and investigate crime
* Protect vulnerable people
* Respond to incidents and emergencies
* Support victims and witnesses
* Keep passengers, railway staff and local communities safe
As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, join a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.
**Entry Requirements**
To be eligible to apply for the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), you must have:
**LEVEL 2**
* Level 2 qualifications in English Language and Maths (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification), **OR**
* be willing to undertake BTP's Level 2 English and Maths assessment if you do not currently hold these qualifications,
**LEVEL 3 OR WORK EXPERIENCE**
**In addition to the above you are also required to have:**
* A Level 3 qualification or above (details below), **OR**
* Have relevant work experience demonstrating an equivalent level of knowledge, responsibility and professional capability (details below)
**Examples of Level 3 qualifications include:**
* Two A-levels at grade E or above (or equivalent, such as a BTEC Level 3, Level 3 T Levels or International Baccalaureate(IB)).
* BTEC National Diploma
* NVQ Level 3
* Access to Higher Education Diploma
* Other recognised Level 3 qualifications
* Policing experience: at least 12 months' relevant experience, including service as a Special Constable (independent patrol status), PCSO and staff. This service must have been completed within the last five years. **OR**
**Work Experience**
We recognise that qualifications are only one measure of potential. If you do not hold a Level 3 qualification, we may consider relevant work experience as an alternative route into policing.
Relevant work experience (24 months service) in one of the following areas:
* Armed Forces / Military service
* Emergency services (e.g. ambulance, fire)
* Revenue Protection Officer / Revenue Inspector
* Railway Enforcement Officer
* Rail Incident Response or Service Delivery Management roles
Candidates will be required to provide evidence of their qualifications and/or experience during the recruitment process. **You will not be eligible to apply if:**
* You cannot demonstrate either a Level 3 qualification OR relevant work experience equivalent to Level 3.
* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been declined/refused vetting in the last two years by BTP or any other police force, NCA, CNC or MOD.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.
### Want to apply?
Applications are completed online.
As part of the process, you will be required to complete Situational Judgement Test's. If you do not pass the SJT assessments, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.
You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.
Please note: This campaign is for new recruits only. Transferees should apply through a transferee-specific vacancy when available.
Successful applicants will join a conditional offer pool and be considered for opportunities for up to 12 months from the date of their conditional offer.
### Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive.
We believe our people are strongest when they reflect the diverse communities we serve, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences.
Whatever your background, identity or experience, you'll be supported throughout the recruitment process and throughout your career with British Transport Police.
Reasonable adjustments are available at every stage of the recruitment process.
### Use of AI in applications
AI can be a useful tool for generating ideas or helping structure written responses, but we want to hear your genuine voice. Personal experiences, authentic motivation and individual insight are what stand out most to us.
**Application deadline: Midnight on Monday 2nd November 2026**
Please note that this campaign may close early if a high volume of applications is received.
For support or assistance with your application, contact the Recruitment Team - recruitmentteam@btp.police.uk

### **#TEAMBULK ARE HIRING A QUALITY ASSURANCE TECHNICIAN**
