# Medialab Launch Programme 2027 - Register Your Interest
**JOIN OUR JOURNEY**
Medialab is the UK’s leading independent media agency, and one of the fastest growing in the industry. We’re a media agency that’s made differently: purpose-led, data-driven, founder-run and proudly independent.
Our entrepreneurial spirit means success is recognised and rewarded. There are no limits to what you can achieve here, which our employees agree with, evidenced by being a Campaign Best Place to Work for six consecutive years and one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2025. As well as this, we’re Campaign’s Independent Agency of the Year 2024 and Media Week’s Independent Agency of the Year 2025.
We are IPA Effectiveness accredited, an IPA People-First agency, and All in Champions, with industry-leading work recognised by double-gold at the 2024 IPA Effectiveness Awards for our work with Laithwaites and a 2025 Effie for our work with Alzheimer’s Society.
Our independence means we can focus 100% on doing the right thing to secure success for our clients and our brilliant people. We work with a wide variety of clients who are the countries most loved brands including Hovis, IG, Sharps Bedrooms, SunLife, Standard Life, Ancestry, Laithwaites Wine, Save the Children, Guide Dogs, Alzheimer’s Society, RNLI and Clearscore.
**OUR VALUES**
* Commit to Doing the Right Thing (Act with integrity and accountability)
* Help People Flourish (Invest in people)
* Dig Deeper to Understand Better (Data driven curiosity)
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU**
Working at Medialab comes with lots of perks including all the usual things you would expect, such as a competitive salary package, pension, season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, weekly social events and big summer / end of year parties. On top of that, we offer extra benefits, which make life at Medialab even more rewarding:
* Time to Unwind – We offer generous holiday entitlement that increases with long service, plus Christmas closure and a birthday day off. Alongside this, we offer flexible benefits including a holiday buy scheme, flexi-hours, a work abroad scheme, cultural bank holiday swaps, and Friday Summer hours.
* Hybrid Working – Balance between home and office (3 Days in Office). We welcome requests for flexible working arrangements from the commencement of employment.
* Career Growth – A meritocratic approach to progression with bi-annual reviews, CPD Platinum accredited training, mentoring and leadership support.
* Health & Wellbeing – Private medical insurance, health cash plan, gym discounts, wellbeing apps Mental Health First Aiders and free professional counselling.
* Supporting Families – Enhanced parental leave pay, flexible working and life assurance.
* Giving Back – Paid charity days and sustainability initiatives.
* Perks & Rewards – Retail discounts, long-service trips and an unforgettable team culture.
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
Following another successful year of growth, we are excited to open applications for our Medialab ‘Launch’ Programme!
‘Launch’ is the entry level point into The Medialab Career Accelerator Programme, our career development framework that maps a successful career in media through three levels of progression, from building your foundations in Launch, to developing as a manager in Lift, and ultimately shaping agency strategy in Lead.
We don’t mind if you are a school leaver or graduate straight out of college or university, if this is your first role, or you come to us with some experience. If you can demonstrate a passion for data, proactivity and drive, we will, in turn, provide you with the platform to kick start your career in Media at a leading and award-winning media agency!
As an Account Executive, you will be at the heart of our high-performing team and the key to our clients' success. This is a fundamentally data-driven, hands-on role where your day-to-day will involve detailed analysis, numerical comfort, and a rigorous approach to campaign performance. You will learn the craft of media from the ground up, working on real campaigns from your very first week, building strong relationships, ensuring accuracy, and applying data to drive brilliant results for our clients.
Depending on where your interests lie, you will join one of three key departments and specialise in one of five core areas:
**CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE**
**Department: Digital**
Perfect for those who love data, digital and optimising real-time campaign performance.
You will choose a specialism, becoming an expert in one of our primary Digital channels, whilst also gaining a basic understanding of the other channels through shared learning experiences.
Specialism: Paid Search
* Master building and optimising paid campaigns on Google and Bing at the exact point customers are searching for answers. You will learn to build campaigns, manage budgets, analyse performance data, run A/B tests and connect client brands with audiences actively looking for them.
Specialism: Paid Social
* Plan and execute campaigns across social media platforms such as Meta (Instagram/Facebook), TikTok Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest & more. You'll learn how to capture audience attention and use data to refine campaign performance.
Specialism: Programmatic Display
* The art and science of automated display, video and connected TV ad buying across the open web. You will learn to use Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) like DV360, The Trade Desk, and Yahoo to target precise audiences, manage real-time bidding (RTB) auctions, and optimise multi-format campaigns to drive brand awareness and performance at scale.
**Department: Client Planning**
Perfect for data-driven strategic thinkers who love decoding audience behaviour, analysing consumption habits, and connecting the dots across the broader media landscape to build impactful campaigns.
Specialism: Media Planning
* Learn how to blend different media channels, from TV and print to digital and social media. You'll use data to understand audiences, contribute to strategic briefs and help build cohesive, high-impact campaigns for our clients.
If you’re unsure which area is the best fit, don't worry! We can help guide you during our initial chat.
**Department: AV**
Specialism: TV, AV & VOD
* Master the art of media buying and activation planning across TV, video-on-demand (VOD), and streaming services. You'll learn how to negotiate with major media owners like Amazon, Netflix, ITV, Channel 4 and Sky, manage campaign plans, delivery and analyse viewing data to ensure ads reach the right audiences with maximum impact.
**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**
As part of the Launch cohort, you will start building your foundation in media immediately. You will:
* **Deliver Data-Driven Success:** Use our tools to populate campaign data accurately, apply performance data to draw insights, and support your team in making proactive campaign improvements & optimisations.
* **Campaign Activation:** Campaign setup, from ensuring accurate tracking to managing budgets and monthly invoicing, ensuring all parameters are met.
* **Build Strong Client Relationships:** Contribute to day-to-day client communication, help prepare for meetings, and respond promptly to queries, always seeking to understand the 'why' behind client objectives.
* **Grow Your Craft Daily:** Work directly within our collaborative teams on live campaigns, applying learnings and frameworks to day-to-day tasks while bringing curiosity and energy to everything you do.
* **Gain Professional Qualifications:** Obtain best-in-class industry qualifications with the IPA, Thinkbox TV Masters , Google Fundamentals as well as bespoke opportunities to learn from the UK’s leading media companies such as ITV and Sky.
**WHAT KIND OF PERSON ARE YOU?**
We are a team of driven, curious, and results orientated people who thrive on delivering exceptional work for our brilliant clients. We place a lot of value on your potential and values - what matters most to us is your mindset, analytical curiosity and your drive.
You will be a great fit if you have:
* **A Data-Driven & Highly Numerate Mindset:** You genuinely enjoy working with maths, data, and analytics. You don’t just accept surface-level facts, you love digging deeper to find the "why" and are excited to use numbers to inform your decisions. A genuine enjoyment of working with data is essential for this role.
* **A Strong Sense of Ownership:** You are proactive, naturally enthusiastic, and take full accountability for your tasks. You work incredibly well within a team, show initiative, and are motivated to take ownership of your role to deliver work we can all be proud of.
* **Agility to thrive in a fast growth environment:**You bring positive energy to your day and can learn with agility and pace. You have the ability to work well under time pressures, staying calm and focused in our dynamic, client-service-led environment.
* **A Naturally Collaborative & Communicative Style:**You are a strong communicator with the natural ability to build trust and strong relationships.
* **Meticulous Attention to Detail:** You take pride in the accuracy of your work, understanding that the small details make a massive difference to our clients.
Your Technical Basics:
* **Excel Foundations:** You are experienced using Excel at a basic level, as a minimum (e.g. comfortable sorting data, formatting, and using basic formulas), and you are eager to learn more advanced data techniques.
* **Microsoft Office Suite:** You have hands-on experience using Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word to organise your day, write clearly, and help build clean presentations.
If you are excited by this opportunity and have the drive and curiosity we are looking for, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to kick-start your career at Medialab!
At Medialab we are committed to fostering a culture that celebrates creative thinking, different perspectives and the many different cultures that exist. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and identities. All qualified applicants will receive fair consideration, regardless of age, disability, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, belief, marital status, social mobility or any other protected characteristic. If you require any reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please reach out to our Head of Talent Acquisition and Inclusion at Kianna.Briggs@medialabgroup.co.uk. Requesting a reasonable adjustment will not affect your application.

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies.

* Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration.

* Turn test results into design changes, then re-test.

* Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation.

* Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

**Nice to have**
* Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware.
* Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

## We're hiring for a Data Protection Administrator to support our growing Technology team!
To support our growth in the UK and Ireland, we're seeking a dedicated Data Protection Administrator to ensure compliance with the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You will also handle data subject access requests, data breach incidents, and data protection impact assessments.
## We're looking for someone with:
* A thorough knowledge and understanding of the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the EU GDPR, as well as other relevant laws and regulations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data protection concepts to different audiences

* High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

* Monitoring and auditing the compliance of our data processing activities with the data protection legislation and our internal policies
* Performing data protection due diligence requirements reviews on new business acquisitions
* Conducting data mapping exercises and classifying data to identify areas of risk and ensure appropriate protection measures are in place
* Overseeing and conducting DPIAs to assess and mitigate risks associated with data processing activities
* Conducting and overseeing Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new projects, systems, or processes involving the processing of personal data
* Providing training and awareness to staff and stakeholders on data protection principles, rights, and obligations
* Acting as the main point of contact for data protection queries and issues, both internally and externally
* Evaluating and managing data protection compliance of third-party vendors and partners
* Managing and responding to data subject access requests, data breach incidents, and data protection impact assessments in a timely and effective manner

* Experience managing multi-jurisdictional entities and working with external corporate service providers.

* Familiarity with public-company governance practices.
* Experience using entity-management platforms and governance tools.

• Audiology follow-up: clinically review audiology outcomes and investigations, advise on next steps, and ensure appropriate follow-up plans (including discharge advice, patient-initiated follow-up where appropriate, or onward ENT review).

Access and use of NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS) and SystmOne (or agreed clinical record systems) in line with local information governance requirements.

*The following are mandatory. Candidates who do not meet every point below will not be eligible for appointment. These requirements align with SSIP Membership Rules, Appendix 6 – Assessor Competence Requirements.*
**To be appointed, you must:**
▪ Hold at least one SSIP-recognised Health & Safety qualification (listed below).
▪ Have a minimum of 2 years’ general Health & Safety experience, with a construction-sector background.
▪ Have appropriate knowledge of relevant UK Health & Safety legislation.
▪ Be an SSIP Registered Assessor, or complete and pass the 1-day SSIP Assessor Training Course within 3 months of appointment, and the 3-yearly SSIP Refresher thereafter.
▪ Have fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to read, interpret and review complex documentation.
**SSIP-recognised Health & Safety qualifications (at least one required):**

▪ NEBOSH Certificate in Construction (preferred — see below)
▪ British Safety Council (BSC) Level 3 Certificate in Occupational Safety & Health
▪ NVQ Level 3 in Occupational Health & Safety
▪ NCRQ Level 6 Certificate in Applied Health & Safety
▪ Or a higher Health & Safety qualification
**PERSON SPECIFICATION – ESSENTIAL**
• **Health & Safety qualification —** hold at least one of the SSIP-recognised qualifications listed above.
• **Construction background —** demonstrable Health & Safety experience within the construction sector and a working understanding of construction risk.
• **Minimum experience —** a minimum of 2 years’ general Health & Safety work experience (SSIP minimum). 3–5 years is preferred.
• **Knowledge of legislation —** appropriate, current knowledge of relevant UK Health & Safety legislation.
• **SSIP Assessor Training —** be an SSIP Registered Assessor, or complete and pass the 1-day SSIP Assessor Training Course within 3 months of appointment.
• **Written & spoken English —** fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to read, interpret and review complex Health & Safety documentation and communicate clearly with all audiences.
• **Attention to detail —** strong attention to detail and the ability to understand and interpret complex documentation accurately.
• **Customer focus —** a customer-centric approach with strong listening, questioning and problem-solving skills.
• **Working style —** positive, self-driven and results-oriented, while working well as part of a team.
• **Systems & organisation —** good administrative and organisational skills, able to prioritise and learn new systems quickly.
• **CPD —** active commitment to Continuing Professional Development, evidenced through IOSH or IIRSM membership and/or CPD records (per SSIP requirements).
**PERSON SPECIFICATION – DESIRABLE**
• **NEBOSH Construction Certificate** or equivalent construction-specific Health & Safety qualification.
• **Tech IOSH membership** (or working towards a professional membership grade).
• **SSIP process awareness —** prior experience of the SSIP process as a supplier/applicant or having worked within an SSIP scheme or Certification Body.
• **Quality background —** experience within a quality assurance, quality control or quality management environment (e.g. ISO 9001, auditing or document-control practices).
• **Building Safety background —** awareness of, or experience with, the Building Safety Act and higher-risk building requirements, or a background in fire or building safety compliance.

# Computational Biologist
Outpost Bio is building models of how microbial communities respond to drugs and other chemicals. We're hiring one person for this role, and they can be based in either London or Boston. Apply to the posting for the city you'd work from. You only need to apply once.

* Work with experimental scientists to refine hypotheses and design controls, replication and follow-up experiments, and with our computational scientists and ML researchers to define biologically meaningful features and benchmarks and investigate where models fail.
* Contribute to existing research initiatives and propose your own in-silico questions as the data supports them. Write reusable analysis code and explain results clearly to colleagues with different scientific backgrounds.
## Your background
* A relevant doctorate, or a master's degree plus at least three years of industry work. Evidence of independent research through papers, preprints or comparable scientific outputs.
* Hands-on experience analyzing metagenomic or 16S data, with a good understanding of microbial biology and the limitations of reference databases and functional annotations.
* Sound statistical reasoning, including experimental design, confounding, repeated measurements, multiple testing and the challenges of compositional data.
* Proficiency in Python and/or R, with experience writing reproducible analysis code using Git and Linux. Other people should be able to understand and rerun your work.
* Comparative genomics, pangenomes, enzyme or pathway annotation, or sequence-based methods.
* Experience working with experimental scientists. You can explain what the data supports, challenge an unsupported interpretation and propose a practical way to resolve uncertainty.
* *Nice to have:* hands-on LC-MS data processing; experience with microbial metabolism or drug biotransformation; biological machine learning, evaluation of learned representations, or large-scale analyses using cloud compute; building shared workflows with Nextflow or Snakemake, or contributing to community bioinformatics software.
## Why Join Outpost Bio?
* **You'll own real equity in what you build.** We offer meaningful stock options because we believe the people building this company should share in what it becomes. We want teammates who think like owners, and we structure compensation to reflect that.
* **Outstanding benefits.** Private medical and dental with Bupa from day one, paid by Outpost, and dependents covered at 50%. Pension with a 3% employer contribution. Life insurance, income protection and critical illness cover, all employer paid. Cycle to Work scheme. 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a paid winter break between Christmas Eve and New Year.
* **An ML Lab-in-the-Loop.** Your work feeds directly into Outpost's AI platform, and the platform feeds back into the next experiment. The loop between the wet lab, the data and the models runs in days, not years, and you'll iterate inside it whichever side you sit on.
* **How we work.** Expected in the office Monday, Wednesday and Friday, with flexible hours around a 10am to 4pm core and up to two weeks a year working from anywhere. Home office stipend and company computer. We cover conference costs and want you presenting your work, and every quarter you get a budget for drinks or coffee to learn from peers at other companies.
* **Small team, outsized reach.** You're joining a small founding team backed by top-tier investors with deep connections across AI and bio. The science you do here will directly shape how pharma and consumer companies understand molecule and microbiome interactions.
## About Outpost Bio
Outpost Bio pairs high-throughput functional assays of human-derived microbial communities with causal machine learning to build predictive models of microbiome-compound interactions. Unlike black-box approaches, our Lab-in-the-Loop process tightly couples experimental design and AI development, so the models inform the science and the science informs the models. We generate large-scale perturbation datasets using stool-derived communities (SDCs) and multi-omic measurements, then train frontier models that predict metabolism, toxicity, and response at the community level. Headquartered in Boston and London, backed by Seedcamp, Merantix, Defined, and Openseed VC.

# Senior Quantitative Researcher/Scientist
## Lead the statistical methodology behind trusted daily KPI indices, advancing forecasting, uncertainty and data quality in Python alongside expert data scientists and engineers.
We are looking for a **Senior Quantitative Researcher** to take a leading role in developing and governing the statistical methodology behind our daily KPI indices.
Our methodology determines how alternative data is transformed into robust estimates of company performance, including how models are specified, validated and governed before publication. It is developed and maintained by the OXDS team and runs every day across several hundred published indices. This is a new, dedicated senior position created to advance that methodology, introducing deeper statistical modelling, stronger uncertainty quantification, more robust approaches for sparse and heterogeneous data, and methods that continue to perform as our data sources and products evolve.
In this role, you will be the senior statistical voice for the index production system, working within the OXDS team alongside software engineers and with data scientists across the product teams.
## Roles and Responsibilities
· Lead the statistical methodology of index production end to end: model specification, estimation, adjustment, validation and forecasting.
· Propose and develop substantial methodological enhancements to improve the quality of our KPI models beyond our existing approaches.
· Own the adjustment and drift-control methodology: scaling, bounds, clipping and the treatment of outstanding corrections, including how thresholds and windows are selected and evidenced.
· Own the statistical treatment of panel and source data before modelling, including coverage, reporting lag, sample drift and representativeness.
· Set standards for the model lifecycle, including specification, validation, backtesting, retraining, and evaluation using only the information available at the time of publication.
· Own the revision methodology for published series, including when restatement is justified and what historical consistency it should preserve.
· Own the statistical logic behind production quality assurance, including input monitoring, outlier detection, alert calibration, and distinguishing data issues from model issues.
· Maintain clear methodology specifications that engineers and data scientists can build against, and review methodological changes proposed by product teams.
· Validate numerical equivalence when statistical libraries or scientific dependencies are upgraded.
· Implement methodology as tested, production-quality Python and take accountability for the statistical correctness of published outputs.
· Deliver training sessions to other data scientists to upskill them in our methodology, especially for new methods you have developed.
· Mentor data scientists and raise statistical standards across the wider team.
## Required Qualifications
### Experience
· 5+ years of work experience in applied statistics, econometrics or quantitative data science or a PhD in a relevant field.
· Demonstrated experience owning statistical methodology in a production system where modelling decisions reached external users.
· Postgraduate training in statistics, econometrics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent applied experience.
### Statistics & Methodology
· Deep understanding of regression modelling and statistical inference, including diagnostics, constrained estimation and uncertainty estimation.
· Strong time-series expertise, including forecasting, seasonality, calendar effects, structural breaks and time-series cross-validation.
· Strong understanding and experience with two or more of the following:
o Bayesian modelling, particularly hierarchical models;
o Kalman filtering;
o Errors-in-variables models;
o Change point detection;
o Conformal prediction;
o Forecast combination (e.g. Bates and Granger method).
· Experience with sampling and panel methodology, including selection bias, unbalanced panels, reweighting and representativeness.
· Experience calibrating thresholds and uncertainty measures for automated decision systems, with sound judgement around false positives and missed errors.
· Ability to reason about methodology under production constraints such as data revisions, missing inputs, short histories and backward compatibility of published series.
### Python

# Senior Manager, Strategic Finance - B2C Marketing

## **We power people’s progress.**
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
## Meet the team!
Marketing is Preply's primary financial lever, and this Finance role sits at its core. Reporting to the Director of FP&A and partnering closely with Preply's Growth team, you'll shape the frameworks we use to determine marketing spend and evaluate return on investment. This is a senior ownership role: you'll interpret analyses from our marketing analytics teams, evaluate current trends, and translate strategic plans from Growth and Brand Marketing into near-term and long-term spend and user acquisition forecasts. You'll own the financial narrative, regularly presenting results and recommendations to senior executives, while analyzing key drivers, risks, and opportunities through comprehensive sensitivity analysis. This is a highly visible and influential role within Preply.
## What you'll be doing:
* **Financial modeling & forecasting** — Build and maintain models connecting marketing spend to acquisition, retention, and *LTV*; produce monthly and quarterly forecasts and variance narratives; run scenario and sensitivity analyses for spend changes and macro shifts.
* ***Incrementality*** **& efficiency** — Partner with the marketing team to evaluate Preply's response curve, geo-lift test results, and media mix modeling. Determine where marginal spend starts to diminish in return, and quantify the paid-to-organic relationship — halo effect, cannibalization, and blended *CAC*.
* **Investment framework & guardrails** — Establish the decision rules, *ROI* thresholds, and spend limits that let the Growth team move fast within clear parameters.
* **Geo expansion** — Size new market opportunities, build the investment case, set the return thresholds that make a market worth entering, and track performance against strategic thesis.
* **Business partnership & reporting** — Act as a trusted Finance partner to the Growth team; translate complex analysis into actionable recommendations for the VP of Growth, COO, and CFO; pressure-test the financial logic behind major marketing initiatives.
* **AI workflow integration** — Use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, research, and model development.
## What you'll need to succeed:
* 8+ years in marketing analytics, growth analytics, performance marketing, or Finance roles closely partnered with these functions, with demonstrated deep domain knowledge in marketing.
* Strong fluency in key marketing metrics and concepts: *incrementality*, marginal *CAC*, *LTV*, retention curves, payback periods, geo-lift/holdout testing, media mix modeling, attribution, and channel efficiency.
* Experience at a high-growth B2C marketplace or subscription business.
* A clear, concise communicator capable of presenting and defending recommendations before executive leadership.
* A proven track record of influencing Growth teams and building operational frameworks that accelerate performance.
* Fluency with Looker, Snowflake/SQL, and advanced Sheets/Excel.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface insights.
* Proven financial modeling capability, or a strong analytical foundation with the ability to master complex modeling quickly.
## Nice to have
* Background in FP&A, strategic finance, or commercial finance.
* Hands-on experience building financial models for user acquisition.
* Experience operating in fast-growing, data-driven marketplaces or tech startups.
## Why you'll love it at Preply:
* Real influence: direct interaction with senior leadership and ownership of decisions on Preply's single biggest financial lever;
* The opportunity to help shape how a category-defining company scales and operates at the next level;
* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
* A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
* A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
* Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;
* Access to free mental health support platforms;
* Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
* The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).
## **Our Principles**
* **Care to change the world** - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
* **We do it for learners** - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

Role Purpose
The Fraud and Financial Crime Investigations Manager is responsible for identifying and investigating suspected criminal, fraudulent and dishonest activity affecting the business, its customers and colleagues.
The role will manage investigations from initial identification through to conclusion, seeking, gathering and assessing evidence, identifying patterns of offending, conducting interviews where appropriate and producing clear investigation reports. The Investigations Manager will work closely with store teams, Loss Prevention, Employee Relations and other internal stakeholders, as well as external agencies where required.
A key focus of the position is moving beyond individual incidents to identify repeat offenders, organised activity, emerging crime trends and weaknesses in processes or controls that may expose the business to further loss.
Key Responsibilities
Investigations
· Conduct thorough investigations into suspected internal and external retail crime, fraud and dishonest activity which may include theft and attempted theft, employee dishonesty and internal fraud, refund, return and exchange abuse, discount, loyalty or promotional abuse and abuse of company processes or systems for financial gain
· Manage investigations from initial allegation or intelligence through to conclusion
· Review available evidence including CCTV, transaction records, till activity, payment information, access records, delivery information and relevant business records
· Establish clear investigation timelines and identify links between incidents, individuals, transactions and locations
· Conduct investigative interviews and obtain relevant accounts or statements in line with company procedures
· Maintain clear, accurate and professional investigation records
· Produce concise investigation reports setting out the evidence, findings and recommended next steps
· Ensure investigations are proportionate, objective and evidence led
Evidence & Case Management
· Gather, assess and preserve evidence appropriately
· Maintain comprehensive investigation files and clear audit trails
· Ensure case records accurately document investigative decisions and actions
· Handle sensitive information with appropriate confidentiality
· Prepare investigation material suitable for internal disciplinary or criminal justice processes where required
· Support requests for evidence from law enforcement or other authorised external bodies in accordance with company procedures
Intelligence & Crime Prevention
· Use internal systems to identify suspicious transactions and behaviour that require further investigation
· Identify repeat offenders, linked incidents and emerging methods of offending
· Analyse investigation information to identify trends, vulnerabilities and potential control weaknesses
· Share relevant intelligence with operational teams and other appropriate stakeholders
· Identify opportunities to prevent recurrence and recommend improvements to processes or controls
Stakeholder & External Partnership
· Build effective working relationships with store management, Loss Prevention, Employee Relations, Legal, Security and operational teams
· Liaise professionally with police and other relevant external agencies where appropriate.
· Provide investigative advice and guidance to colleagues
· Communicate complex investigation findings clearly to both operational and senior stakeholders
· Support the business in understanding emerging retail crime and fraud risks through training and communication

Essential
· Experience in retail investigations, loss prevention, fraud investigation, security, law enforcement or a comparable investigative environment
· Strong investigative and analytical skills
· Ability to assess information objectively and distinguish evidence from assumption
· Strong attention to detail and ability to identify connections across multiple incidents or data sources
· Experience producing clear written investigation reports
· Confident communication and interviewing skills, Wicklander-Zulawski trained an advantage
· Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
· Strong organisational and case-management skills
· Ability to manage multiple investigations and competing priorities
· Sound judgement and confidence when making evidence-based recommendations
Desirable
· Experience investigating internal fraud or employee dishonesty
· Experience of investigations involving high-value retail environments
· Knowledge of payment fraud, refund abuse, organised retail crime or ecommerce fraud
· Experience working with CCTV and transaction-monitoring data
· Experience liaising with police or other external agencies, including writing of MG11s and exhibiting of appropriate evidence
· Relevant investigative, fraud, security or financial crime qualification

### Job Introduction
As a Finance Manager, you'll be a key member of the Finance Team, delivering an end-to-end financial service covering planning, commercial analysis and management accounts. You'll be the primary finance contact for your business area, providing clear financial information alongside the commercial insight that drives real decisions.
You'll lead up to two Finance Analysts, taking responsibility for their day-to-day support, workload planning and professional growth. You'll be an engaged and motivating manager, enabling regular development conversations and providing on-the-job coaching in both technical and leadership skills. This role suits a qualified finance professional who is curious, confident and genuinely interested in how the business works.
# Key Responsibilities
* Finance ownership of stock (including stock loss) and the distribution centre – allowing clear financial ownership and support of the end to end stock strategy. However, depending on business needs and focus, there may be opportunity to support in other areas.
* Identify and develop timely, relevant analysis that gives business partners real insight, helping them to manage their areas more profitably.
* Prepare business cases for investment decisions and complete post-investment reviews, considering broader business implications.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with business area leadership, monitoring risks and opportunities to the P&L and engaging stakeholders to manage them effectively.
* Complete cost/benefit analysis and identify opportunities to improve productivity and profitability.
* Deliver monthly management accounts, with robust variance analysis and a clear narrative on performance.
* Lead the budgeting, forecasting and long range planning process for your area, working under the broader direction of your Senior Finance Manager.
* Prepare and own balance sheet reconciliations, mapping complex processes and clearly articulating risks and opportunities to senior stakeholders.
* Drive process improvements across your area, working collaboratively with the wider Finance Team to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Manage and develop a team of up to two Finance Analysts, ensuring they have clear objectives, structured reviews and on-the-job coaching to support their development.
* Deputise for your Senior Finance Manager when required.
# Behaviours
* Relationship Building - develops effective relationships with business area leadership; creates collaborative, honest relationships with direct reports and Finance peers; builds connections across functions outside their immediate area.
* Challenge & Influence - works with business partners to clarify the drivers of financial performance; reviews analysis to form an independent point of view; actively manages risks and opportunities and ensures business partners have appropriate actions to address them.
* Communication - proactively communicates progress and impacts with stakeholders; adapts style and approach to the audience; presents financial information in a clear and engaging way to inform commercial decision-making.
* Responsiveness & Proactivity - earns the trust of business partners by acting honestly when expectations can't be met; advises on a broader range of issues; proactively reaches out to stakeholders and leads the agenda for meetings.
* Balance Sheet Accuracy - maps complex balance sheet processes and implications for monthly balances; articulates the reconciliation process to senior stakeholders; ensures accuracy of balance sheets prepared by self and team.
* Understanding the P&L - monitors risks and opportunities to the P&L; engages stakeholders to manage these effectively; works collaboratively with business partners to produce challenging and achievable plans.
* Financial Modelling & Presentation - builds simple, future-proofed models that handle complex scenarios; provides clear outputs with scenarios, sensitivities and recommendations; presents analysis clearly and concisely to stakeholders.
* Identifying Risks & Opportunities - reviews business area performance and identifies where further modelling and analysis could surface risks or opportunities; provides coaching to the team on analytical approach.
* Planning to Deliver - plans and manages team activity to ensure timely delivery; demonstrates agility in response to changing priorities; proactively looks ahead and manages stakeholder expectations.
* Improving Processes - works collaboratively across Finance and the business to drive efficiency and accuracy; proactively works with business partners to improve processes and strengthen controls.
* Values & Culture - role models leadership behaviours, champions team wellbeing and contributes to a culture where everyone is comfortable bringing their authentic self to work.
* AI & Technology - embraces AI and emerging technologies with curiosity and confidence; proactively identifies opportunities to use new tools to improve financial processes, reporting and analysis, and encourages the team to do the same.
# Skills & Experience
* Fully qualified accountant - CIMA, ACCA, ACA or international equivalent.
* Experience managing or mentoring a Finance Analyst is desirable.
* Strong commercial awareness, ideally in a fast-paced business environment.
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills; ability to build models from scratch that stand the test of time.
* Experience with financial systems and using AI technologies

Business Analyst - Rising Executive Programme The Bicester Collection are the world’s leading luxury shopping destinations, and we are committed to creating magical and memorable experiences for our guests. Taking the name of the founding Village, The Bicester Collection distinguishes the 12 Villages in Europe, North America and China, as one collection of destinations for our guests, our brand partners, our travel and tourism partners, our corporate and financial media, and our internal teams.
The Villages are located close to some of most celebrated cities: London, Milan, Munich, Dublin, Barcelona, Madrid, Paris, Brussels, Frankfurt, New York, Suzhou, and Shanghai. Our Vision is to be the best shopping destination in the world. Our Mission is to make the lives of others better - our brands, our guests, our people and our communities.Our Brand Promise is to offer something extraordinary every day. Our Five Values are the glue that bind us together and allows us to lead ahead.
• Authenticity - Always do the right thing • Innovation - Think outside of the box • Passion - Do what you love and love what you do!
• Critical Thinking - Challenge the obvious • Vision - Be mission driven always
About the Rising Executive Programme
The Rising Executive Program is a transformative rotational journey designed to equip high-potential early career professionals with the essential skills for future leadership in our business. Participants at the Business Analyst level will spend two years in the program to immerse themselves in diverse geographies and business functions, gaining firsthand insights into the core drivers that propel our European, UK, and USA operations.
The rotational program offers a set of development opportunities, including strategic projects, task forces, and networking events, complemented by targeted trainings, workshops, and conferences to hone management and leadership skills. Rigorous performance development ensures that Rising Executive candidates are successfully meeting and exceeding program competencies and showing excellent potential to progress in our business.
Towards the end of the program, each candidate who has successfully passed their competency reviews will collaborate with the Program Director to craft their next steps: either into the next level of the program (to become a Business Planning Manager and continue their development) or into another role in the business.
The Rising Executive Program is present in all of our European Villages and the newly opened Belmont Park Village in New York, USA. As a Business Analyst in this program, you may be asked to work in any of these locations throughout your journey in the program.
**About the Role:** As a Rising Executive Business Analyst, you will support your local leadership team as well as with the Group to compile and analyse all of our key performance data and KPIs. Your key role is to provide the insights needed to support effective business planning. This is an ideal role for someone with at least two years of experience in a commercial area, adequate financial understanding and who is passionate about developing into a management role in a commercial function.
Your role as a Business Analyst will deepen your understanding of the operations within teams, the core levers of our business and our KPIs, and give you the opportunity to contribute towards the overall strategy of a Village or department. You will assist Value Retail (VR) in positively affecting the performance of the brands by analysing and providing invaluable information and developing trust, thereby building closer relationships with our brands.
As a Rising Executive in this position, you will be expected to contribute creative solutions and insights in all of your key areas, with a focus on data precision and valuable insights to help move our decisions forward. You will also participate in Rising Executive Conferences and projects to enhance your breadth of knowledge about our business and network with senior leaders.
**Key responsibilities** The key responsibilities of this role will include some or all the following. • Conduct analysis and produce insightful information to foster the collaboration between local and central teams for your function.• Develop complete fluency in our tools and systems for managing our data (PowerBI, Excel, Salesforce, etc), using these tools effectively and with high precision, making adaptations when needed. • Analyse and collate information to be sent to the senior management to ensure all of our partners have a high level of attention from VR, whether they are brands, B2B partnerships, external parties, or investors. • Help your team in developing innovative ways to use technology and systems to better manage brand performance data, and to provide new value added services. • Maintain good working relationships across all other departments. # Marketing Executive | THG Manufacturing
Division
THG Nutrition Manufacturing
Location
UK, Warrington

Full-time
**About THG** We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?
**Location: Omega, WA5 3TP (3 days) / Icon 1, WA15 0AF (2 days)**
**About THG Manufacturing**
**THG Manufacturing** is the dedicated, high-growth contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing division of THG PLC. Operating from state-of-the-art, BRCGS-accredited manufacturing facilities globally, we partner with prestigious household names and global powerhouse brands who trust us to formulate, produce, and scale their product ranges.
Our specialised manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Powder Blending** (sports nutrition, lifestyle powders, functional health formulations)
* **Tablets & Capsules** (vitamins, minerals, and dietary supplements)
* **Protein Bar Manufacturing** (extruded, layered, and premium enrobed formats)
* **Fruit Preparations & Concentrates** (aseptic processing and clean-label infusions)
**An Unrivaled Growth Trajectory**
This is an exceptional time to join our division. THG Manufacturing achieved **300% growth this year**, is forecast to deliver another **100% growth next year**, and is firmly on track to expand into a **£100 million division within 5 years purely in co-manufacturing**. Global powerhouse brands trust us under multi-year co-manufacturing agreements, validating our industry credibility, technical excellence, and manufacturing reliability.
**About the Role**
We are seeking an ambitious Marketing Executive to support the delivery of global B2B marketing activity for THG Manufacturing. Reporting directly to and working alongside the Commercial Director, you will help build the THG Manufacturing co-manufacturing brand and deliver campaigns that strengthen awareness, engagement, and commercial growth across FMCG, wellness, and sports nutrition markets worldwide.
In this hands-on role, you will support activity across demand generation, digital marketing, brand positioning, industry trade shows, content, and sales enablement across our core manufacturing technologies.
**As a Marketing Executive you will:**
**Brand & Market Positioning**
* Reinvent the Brand: Support the repositioning and development of the visual identity of THG Manufacturing, elevating our presence as an elite, premium global co-manufacturer.
* Value Proposition: Support the development and articulation of differentiated value propositions for each capability pillar (powders, bars, tableting/capsules, and fruit preparations).
* Market Intelligence: Monitor global FMCG, nutraceutical, and co-manufacturing industry trends, competitive movements, and ingredient innovations to identify strategic growth opportunities.
**Lead Generation & Digital Marketing**
* Demand Generation: Support the planning, implementation, and optimisation of inbound and outbound B2B lead generation campaigns to supply our commercial sales team with high-value pipeline opportunities.
* Digital Ecosystem & Website: Support the development, optimisation, and ongoing maintenance of the THG Manufacturing digital presence, creating an intuitive, high-converting digital storefront.
* SEO & Content Strategy: Support technical and content SEO activity to strengthen organic search visibility for contract manufacturing, private label, and co-manufacturing terms globally.
* Paid & Performance Marketing: Support targeted B2B paid media (LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Search, programmatic B2B networks) with a sharp focus on CAC, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and ROI.
**Exhibitions, Trade Shows & Experiential Marketing**
* Global Event Presence: Support the planning, design, and execution of world-class exhibition stands at leading international industry trade shows (e.g., Vitafoods Europe, SupplySide West, Food Matters Live, Fi Europe).
* End-to-End Activation: Coordinate stand build logistics, booth design, interactive sampling stations, pre-show outreach, on-site engagement, and rigorous post-event lead qualification.
**Sales Enablement & Marketing Collateral**
* Collateral Suite: Coordinate the creation of best-in-class capability decks, interactive digital brochures, technical specification sheets, whitepapers, video tours, and case studies.
* Commercial Alignment: Partner closely with Commercial Directors, Business Development Managers, and R&D/NPD teams to ensure marketing assets directly accelerate commercial sales cycles.
**PR, Communications & Content**
* Industry PR: Support relationships with key trade publications, industry bodies, and B2B media to secure high-profile features, thought leadership placement, and award recognitions.
* Leadership Visibility: Support the positioning of THG Manufacturing key leaders as authoritative voices on supply chain resilience, formulation science, and manufacturing quality.
**What skills and experience do I need for this role?**
**Essential Requirements**
* B2B Marketing Experience: Relevant experience (typically 1-2 years or recent marketing graduate) delivering B2B marketing activity within B2B manufacturing, contract/co-manufacturing, FMCG, ingredients, packaging, or life sciences.
* End-to-End Brand Building: Experience supporting brand development or repositioning within B2B markets in competitive international markets.
* Commercial Acumen & Lead Gen: Experience supporting lead generation through integrated campaigns, digital channels, content, or industry events.
* Digital Mastery: Working knowledge of B2B digital marketing, CMS platforms, SEO, LinkedIn marketing, and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.
* Exhibition Expertise: Experience supporting trade shows, exhibitions, events, or other B2B marketing activations.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across commercial, operations, technical, and leadership teams.
**Desirable Attributes**
* Prior experience in nutritional products, sports nutrition, nutraceuticals, food and beverage processing, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Familiarity with BRCGS, GMP, and food safety standards to translate compliance and technical excellence into compelling marketing narratives.
* International marketing experience across North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC.
**Working Pattern & Office Locations**
Collaboration and close proximity to our manufacturing plants are essential to our operational velocity. This role is site based.
* **3 Days per week:** THG Omega Campus, Warrington (flagship operational & manufacturing campus)
* **2 Day per week:** Icon 1, Manchester Airport (THG Global Headquarters)
**What's in it for me?**
**Career Development**
* Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
* Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
* Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!

* Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
* Buy back up to 3 days each year.
* Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

* Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
* Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
* State-of-the-art on-site gym.
* Access to our on-site physio.
**Other Perks**
* Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
* Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.
* Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

The DNA Motors group studies the Structural Maintenance of Chromosomes (SMC) complexes – cohesin, condensin and SMC5/6 – using cryo-EM, single-molecule biophysics, biochemical reconstitution and cell biology. **Job Summary:**
We’re hiring a hands-on DevOps Engineer to help build, automate and operate our growing Azure and AWS cloud environments. This is a broad engineering role covering cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, observability, reliability, security and Cloud FinOps. You’ll work closely with development, infrastructure, security and application teams to make it easier and faster to build, deploy and operate technology in the cloud – while ensuring that what we build is secure, resilient, supportable and cost-effective. It’s an especially exciting time to join. AI is rapidly changing both the applications we run and the way software itself is developed. New AI workloads, increased automation, accelerated development cycles and more dynamic infrastructure requirements are changing what organisations need from their cloud platforms. You’ll have an opportunity to help shape how we respond: building reusable cloud patterns, improving developer experience, automating the software delivery lifecycle and helping us adopt new technologies without creating unnecessary complexity or uncontrolled cloud spend. If you enjoy automating things that shouldn’t be manual, improving platforms rather than simply keeping them running, and solving interesting problems across Azure and AWS, we’d like to meet you.
**Job Description:**
We’re looking for a practical DevOps Engineer who enjoys working across cloud infrastructure, software delivery and automation.
You’ll help us design and operate reliable Azure and AWS environments, build reusable infrastructure and deployment patterns, improve CI/CD, automate operational processes and give development teams better ways to consume cloud services.
You’ll also play an important role in Cloud FinOps. Cloud platforms make it incredibly easy to consume technology – and equally easy to spend money unnecessarily. We want someone who considers cost an engineering metric alongside performance, reliability and security, and who can help us improve visibility, accountability and optimisation of cloud consumption.
As AI becomes increasingly important across the organisation, you’ll also help us evolve our cloud engineering practices to support AI-enabled applications, more dynamic workloads and a development lifecycle increasingly augmented by AI.
This is not a role where you’ll simply administer existing environments. We want someone who will challenge how things are done, automate repetitive work, introduce better patterns and leave the platform in a better state than they found it.
**What You’ll Do**
**Cloud & Platform Engineering:** Design, build and operate resilient infrastructure across both Azure and AWS, covering compute, storage, databases, networking and managed platform services. Build reusable patterns and help development teams select the right services based on performance, resilience, security, operational complexity and cost.
**Infrastructure as Code:** Drive automated infrastructure provisioning using modern IaC tools, with a strong preference for modular, repeatable patterns using Terraform and native cloud templates where appropriate. Ensure environments are created predictably through version control, automated validation, appropriate deployment controls and policy guardrails.
**CI/CD & Software Delivery:** Build and maintain delivery pipelines using platforms such as Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. Automate build, testing, security scanning, artefact management and deployment activities, and help teams move towards smaller, repeatable and lower-risk releases.
**Containers & Cloud-Native Platforms:** Support containerised workloads using technologies such as Docker and managed container platforms including AKS, EKS, ECS and Azure Container Apps. Apply Kubernetes where it genuinely adds value, while recognising when a simpler managed service is the better engineering choice.
**Platform Engineering & Developer Experience:** Treat the internal platform as a product. Create self-service capabilities, reusable infrastructure modules, standard hosting patterns, secrets and configuration management, standard CI/CD pipelines and “golden paths” so development teams can consume cloud services without needing to become infrastructure experts.
**Observability, Reliability & Operations:** Improve availability and visibility across application and infrastructure layers. Build actionable monitoring, centralised logging and alerting focused on signal rather than noise. Support incident investigation, root-cause analysis, backup and recovery, resilience and disaster-recovery planning, and turn lessons from incidents into permanent engineering improvements.
**Automation:** Identify repetitive infrastructure, deployment and operational activities and replace them with reliable automation using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, Terraform and cloud-native tooling. Reduce operational toil and create self-service capabilities wherever practical.
**Cloud Security:** Partner with Security to embed security into cloud platforms and delivery pipelines, including least-privilege IAM and RBAC, workload identities, secrets and certificate management, network segmentation, secure configuration, vulnerability management, logging and auditability, and secure CI/CD. Avoid unnecessary long-lived credentials and excessive permissions.
**Cloud FinOps & Cost Optimisation:** Embed cost efficiency into everyday engineering decisions. Improve spend visibility and ownership, establish tagging and budget standards, detect anomalous expenditure, identify idle and underutilised resources, rightsize workloads, optimise storage, evaluate Reservations, Savings Plans and other commitment models, and improve forecasting of future cloud requirements.
**Evolving for AI Workloads:** Help design cloud infrastructure ready for AI-enabled applications, model and API consumption, dynamic workloads, event-driven architectures and high-performance compute. Help ensure that engineering controls, security, monitoring and cost management evolve alongside an increasingly AI-accelerated software development lifecycle.
**What You’ll Bring**
**Hands-on Multi-Cloud Experience:** Proven experience building, operating and troubleshooting workloads across **both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services**, including compute, storage, databases, networking and managed platform services.
**IaC & Automation Mindset:** Strong expertise in declarative Infrastructure as Code, ideally Terraform, together with practical scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar technologies to eliminate repetitive operational activity.
**Delivery & Source Control Expertise:** Practical experience designing and maintaining continuous integration and delivery pipelines using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, together with strong Git and modern source-control practices.
**Networking & Security Fundamentals:** Strong understanding of cloud networking including VNets/VPCs, routing, firewalls, load balancing, DNS and private connectivity, together with IAM, RBAC, workload identities and secure cloud configuration.
**Observability & Reliability:** Experience operating production services, including monitoring, logging, incident investigation, resilience, backup and recovery, and the ability to turn recurring operational issues into permanent engineering improvements.
**Cloud FinOps:** Practical understanding of cloud cost drivers and experience analysing, optimising and forecasting cloud expenditure. We’re particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable examples of reducing cloud costs without adversely affecting service quality.
**Agile Collaboration:** Comfortable working in cross-functional Agile, Scrum or Kanban environments, breaking work into manageable deliverables and shipping improvements continuously.
**Pragmatic Problem Solver:** Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, networking and cloud services. Able to balance speed, security, reliability, maintainability and cost, favouring operational simplicity and managed services over unnecessary complexity.
You’ll also need good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with developers, security engineers, infrastructure teams, architects and business stakeholders.
**Nice to Have**
* Azure and/or AWS certifications.
* FinOps Foundation certification or significant practical FinOps experience.
* Kubernetes certification or significant Kubernetes experience.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service cloud capabilities.
* Experience with Azure Landing Zones or AWS Control Tower.
* Experience supporting AI or machine-learning workloads, including Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock.
* Experience supporting GPU or other high-performance cloud workloads.
* Experience working in large, distributed or multi-business environments, particularly environments created through acquisition or organisational change.
